title: Story Draft Builder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners write each of the six components of a predictive-maintenance customer story following drafting tips, then see the assembled draft with a structural checklist and an example to compare.

learningObjectives: Construct a story draft by writing content for each story component (hook, problem, agitation, solution, social proof, call to action) following drafting best practices.

keyQuestions: Construct a story draft by writing content for each story component (hook, problem, agitation, solution, social proof, call to action) following drafting best practices.
commonMisconceptions: Components can be in any order.
assessmentOpportunities: All six components completed in order.
At least five of six structural checks pass after revision.
